description:
Role Summary

Our mission at HubSpot is to help millions of organizations grow better. As AI transforms how work gets done, HubSpot is building a Builder Platform that unites our ecosystem, data platform, and agent capabilities into a cohesive experience for developers, partners, and go-to-market builders.

As Senior Director, Ecosystem Product, you will define and execute the ecosystem strategy that powers HubSpot's Builder Platform vision. You will lead the developer platform, APIs, MCP strategy, marketplace, strategic integrations, and builder experiences that enable customers, partners, and AI agents to build on HubSpot.

This role sits at the intersection of developer ecosystems, agent platforms, marketplaces, and go-to-market workflows. You will help shape how first-party, second-party, and third-party agents work together to deliver customer outcomes while creating new opportunities for ecosystem growth and monetization.

What You’ll Do

Define and execute the ecosystem strategy that supports HubSpot's Builder Platform vision, enabling developers, partners, and go-to-market builders to create solutions on and around HubSpot. 

Shape how first-party, second-party, and third-party agents interact with HubSpot through APIs, MCP, and emerging agent frameworks. 

Drive API parity initiatives so customers and partners can access HubSpot capabilities consistently through both UI and programmatic interfaces. 

Partner closely with Data Platform, Partnerships, and Product Hub leaders to create a unified builder experience across HubSpot's intelligence, data, and work layers. 

Develop monetization strategies for APIs, ecosystem products, and agent-powered experiences that support HubSpot's transition toward outcome-based and consumption-based business models. 

Lead and develop a senior, multi-team product organization across platform, marketplace, and ecosystem experiences.

Build a seamless developer experience by improving API/MCP quality, documentation, tooling, governance, and platform reliability.

Define how developers, partners, and go-to-market builders create AI-powered applications, workflows, agents, and integrations that drive measurable customer outcomes. 

Drive a best-in-class marketplace experience that enables customers to discover, evaluate, and adopt ecosystem solutions.

Partner cross-functionally with Developer Relations, Partnerships, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to embed ecosystem solutions into the flywheel.

Establish operating models, decision frameworks, and execution cadences that enable fast, data-driven ecosystem innovation.

Represent HubSpot externally with developers, partners, and industry leaders to shape ecosystem strategy and credibility.

What You’ll Bring

Required Qualifications

10+ years of product management experience, including leadership of large, multi-team product organizations.

Proven success building and scaling developer platforms, APIs, app marketplaces, or ecosystem products serving large developer, partner, or builder communities. 

Experience evolving platforms to support AI-powered workflows, agents, MCP-enabled experiences, or agent ecosystems.

Experience working with partner ecosystems, strategic integrations, marketplaces, or platform monetization models. 

Track record of turning ecosystems into growth drivers that impact acquisition, retention, or revenue.

Strong perspective on AI, agents, platform ecosystems, and how agentic workflows change the design of developer platforms, marketplaces, and customer experiences. 

Experience partnering with Developer Relations, developer communities, partner programs, or ecosystem-facing functions. 

Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders at the executive level.

Experience with CRM, marketing, sales, or service ecosystems.

Experience in high-growth SaaS environments where ecosystem strategy is core to differentiation.

title: Senior Product Manager II, CRM Data Relationships
description:
POS-11465

The HubSpot CRM is built on relationships. Underneath every contact, deal, ticket, and activity is a set of primitives that defines how records are created and how they connect to one another. These aren't just data structures — they're the foundation that every HubSpot product, every workflow, and every AI-powered feature depends on to function. The Data Platform organization owns that foundation, and we're at an inflection point in how it will evolve.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager II to lead one of the most consequential platform areas in HubSpot: the systems that govern how records relate to each other and how new records come into existence. You'll own a full vertical spanning three teams — from the foundational data infrastructure all the way up to the admin and rep-facing UI surfaces that customers use every day. This is rare: a role where you'll need to hold a complex technical system in your head while simultaneously caring deeply about whether the experience is intuitive enough for a sales rep to use without training.

This moment is especially exciting. We're rethinking how these systems should work as agents and third-party tools begin acting on behalf of customers. When an AI agent is navigating a customer's CRM, the web of associations it relies on needs to be accurate, consistent, and rich. A well-designed associations model is no longer just a UX nicety — it's infrastructure for intelligence. The work you do here will determine whether HubSpot's data model can power that future.

Success in this role will be measured by two things: growing the number of meaningful relationships represented in HubSpot, and building systems that are intuitive enough to scale across the full range of our customers — from a small business managing a few contacts to an enterprise running a sophisticated multi-object data architecture.

In this role you'll get to:

Own the full roadmap across three teams — from the foundational systems that define how records relate, to the UI surfaces that admins and reps use to create and manage those relationships

Define the long-term vision for how HubSpot's associations model evolves: expanding the types of relationships the platform can represent, increasing consistency across the data model, and making relational data available everywhere in the product

Own how new records get created across HubSpot — designing experiences that are fast and intuitive for humans while being reliable and structured enough for AI agents and third-party tools to act on

Drive data quality and completeness across the associations and record creation surface — ensuring that the full web of relationships is captured at the right moment in a record's lifecycle, and that the data customers and AI agents act on is trustworthy, consistent, and as complete as possible

Drive alignment across a wide set of teams that consume the HubSpot data model — to ensure the associations platform evolves in a backward-compatible, forward-looking way

Collaborate directly with AI and agent-owning teams to ensure agents can accurately interpret and act on a company's complex web of relationships to drive efficiency gains for customers

Engage directly with customers — from SMBs to enterprise teams running multi-object architectures — to deeply understand where relational data breaks down in practice

Balance near-term quality improvements with a long-term architectural vision, sequencing work thoughtfully across infrastructure and experience layers

Represent the roadmap to senior leadership, Ecosystem partners, and key enterprise customers

We are looking for people who have:

Experience launching products successfully to customers, ideally in platform, data infrastructure, or CRM contexts

The ability to hold both a keen eye for detail and a long-term vision simultaneously — you can zoom in on a broken UX pattern and zoom out to a multi-year platform strategy without losing either thread

Strong intuition for experience design: you believe that foundational systems should be as intuitive as they are powerful, and you push for UI and workflows that don't require a manual

Deep curiosity about how complex systems work — you're not satisfied with understanding the surface; you want to know what's underneath it and why it was built that way

A track record of driving alignment across many stakeholders: you can build consensus across engineering, design, and cross-functional product teams without losing momentum

The ability to explain complex technical concepts in language accessible to a broad range of users — from enterprise architects to everyday reps

A multidisciplinary approach, combining customer empathy, technical depth, and business judgment to prioritize and sequence platform work

The ability to make decisions, test assumptions, and iterate — often without perfect information and with meaningful platform risk

A deep respect for the expertise of collaborators, including engineering, design, UX research, analytics, and go-to-market partners

As a member of the Product Management org at HubSpot you'll:

Join a product-led culture that truly puts the customer first

Create and advance an ambitious product strategy driven by customer needs, business goals, powerful data, and global market indicators

Partner closely with colleagues in UX and Engineering to create a high-value product that's both powerful and easy to use

Use your voice, share your perspective, and have a real impact based on your point of view

Know what will lead to getting promoted, and why, thanks to clear expectations and robust career paths

Be empowered to show up as your authentic self and choose a work style and location where you can do your best work, whether that's at home, in an office, or a blend of the two

description:
As a Small Business Account Executive at HubSpot, you use outbound and inbound selling strategies to find new business and help them grow using HubSpot software. You benefit from inbound leads and research prospects to create outreach strategies. You run online demos of the HubSpot software and successfully sell the HubSpot value proposition. Your target clients will largely consist of small sized businesses. 

What are the responsibilities of an Account Executive?

In this role, you will need to:

Quickly identify challenges that our prospective customers face and discover the best inbound marketing solutions for their business

Consistently close new business at or above quota level

Build relationships with prospects and internal stakeholders to grow new business

Work collaboratively with HubSpot's marketing and technology departments to evolve our sales strategy when new features and products are introduced 

Help shape the future of HubSpot's mission with your perspectives, ideas, and skills

What are the role requirements?

1+ year of full sales cycle experience

Fluency in both German and English

Unmatched consultative selling and closing skills

Accurate forecasting and pipeline management

Track record of being a high performer (e.g. over quota, President's Club)

A sharp focus on your goals and a strong approach for achieving them

This role is open to remote candidates based in Ireland

Who exceeds in this role?

Top performers in the Account Executive position usually have:

Experience working in a high-growth, "scale up" environment, 

Passion for helping businesses grow and curiosity about the tech industry

Humility and enthusiasm in their work

Interactive employee training and onboarding 

An education allowance up to €4,250 per annum

Build and optimize the performance of data pipelines and analytical tools for scale

Own and evolve core platform assets, AE tooling, reusable patterns, and automation that raise the floor for every AE on the team

Contribute to our composable agentic AE delivery system, a pipeline of AI-powered skills that automates the full delivery lifecycle from context to merged PR

Design and maintain semantic models that serve as the trusted, reusable foundation for analytics and AI consumption across the organization

Build internal AI agents and data-grounded tools, integrating RPC-based capabilities via MCP servers

Design and implement cost strategies for shared data assets, pipelines, and compute usage

Define and deploy scalable data ingestion, replication, and transfer patterns across systems

Foster innovation with emerging technologies and by staying current with industry trends

Guide professional development of the team through technical leadership

Partner with stakeholders to solve business problems with technical solutions

Build out scalable data models to analyze key parts of the HubSpot business

Expand our suite of dbt patterns and macros to enable flexible and easily extensible data structures

Drive data observability and pipeline reliability using tools like Monte Carlo

Establish scalable patterns and standards for analytical application development in Hex

Lead working groups, scope requirements, and usher projects through the entire lifecycle

Maintain detailed documentation of data pipelines, processes, and best practices

Expert knowledge of modern data tools (such as Snowflake, dbt, and Looker)

Deep dbt expertise including advanced modeling patterns, macros, and package development

Experience developing slowly changing dimension (SCD) tables from multiple sources

Successful experience leading complex, cross-functional data initiatives from ambiguous problem to production

Experience building or maintaining shared data platform assets, developer toolkits, or internal frameworks

Experience designing semantic models or metric layers for analytics or AI consumption

Comfort building AI agents and integrating external tools and services via MCP servers

title: Staff Technical Lead - Marketing Studio Intelligence
description:
POS-11333

Staff Technical Lead - Marketing Studio Intelligence

Location: UK - Remote, Flex, or Office

Our mission at HubSpot is to help millions of organizations grow better. Marketing Studio Intelligence is building the intelligence layer behind HubSpot’s next-generation marketing platform. We bring together campaign performance, marketing assets, CRM data, and AI to help marketers understand what’s working, uncover opportunities, and discover what to do next. 

This is a deeply customer-focused space, where we work closely with marketers to understand real problems and turn rapidly evolving AI capabilities into simple, trustworthy experiences that deliver meaningful value.

As a Staff Technical Lead, you’ll lead a small team of 2 - 3 engineers while staying deeply hands-on. You’ll partner closely with Product and UX to shape and build AI systems at scale, tackling ambitious problems across agentic systems, intelligent decisioning, AI quality, and evaluation.

What You’ll Do

Lead a small team of 2 engineers, setting technical direction and helping the team deliver against shared product and engineering goals.

Design, build, and evolve backend services that power campaign integrations, measurement, automation, and intelligent capabilities across Marketing Studio.

Stay hands on with development, contributing production quality Java code and working directly on the team’s most important technical challenges.

Lead technical design for integrations between Marketing Studio, HubSpot campaign systems, marketing assets, CRM data, and other platform capabilities.

Build scalable systems that support campaign performance reporting, attribution, analytics, and intelligent recommendations.

Help shape backend capabilities for AI powered experiences that use campaign context, CRM data, and engagement history to generate insights and recommendations.

Break complex initiatives into clear technical plans and help engineers navigate architecture decisions, dependencies, tradeoffs, and delivery risks.

Coach and mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, feedback, and day to day technical guidance.

Partner with Product and UX to shape priorities and translate customer problems into technical approaches that balance speed, quality, and long term system health.

Drive alignment across engineering teams when work spans shared services, campaign infrastructure, data systems, integrations, or Studio platform capabilities.

What You’ll Bring

Significant experience designing, building, and operating backend software systems in production environments.

Strong Java development skills and experience building production grade backend services, as well as Kafka, MySQL or comparable backend technologies. 

Experience technically leading a small engineering team while remaining an active contributor to the codebase.

Experience coaching and mentoring engineers and helping others grow their technical skills and ownership.

Strong understanding of system design, scalability, reliability, performance, fault tolerance, testing, and observability.

Experience designing and delivering AI-powered products, agentic workflows, AI agents, recommendation systems, decisioning systems, personalization, or next-best-action experiences.

Experience building the backend orchestration, services, APIs, and feedback loops that connect AI or ML models to real customer actions and outcomes.

Experience working with complex, high-volume data and ensuring AI outputs are relevant, explainable, trustworthy, and useful to customers.

Experience defining evaluation, monitoring, and learning mechanisms to assess the quality and impact of AI-generated recommendations or insights.

Ability to partner effectively with ML and data science teams to integrate and productionize models, without necessarily owning model training or core ML infrastructure.

Strong product judgment and customer empathy, with the ability to identify which insights will create genuine value and how they should be presented to customers.

Ability to communicate complex AI concepts clearly and influence Product, Engineering, UX, Design, and business stakeholders.

Nice to Have Qualifications

Direct experience with recommendation systems, decisioning, personalization, ranking, experimentation, or next-best-action products.

Experience integrating CRM, marketing, campaign, advertising, or customer data across multiple systems.

Experience in marketing technology or other domains where products help customers make data-informed decisions.

Experience with Python or another transferable backend language in addition to, or instead of, Java. Check out our engineering blog to learn more.

Direct marketing or recommendation-system experience is a plus, but not required. We also welcome candidates with transferable experience building customer-facing AI products in areas such as customer support, prospecting, content, advertising, or other decision-support domains.

At HubSpot, we value both flexibility and connection. Whether you’re a Remote employee or work from the Office, we want you to start your journey here by building strong connections with your team and peers. If you are joining our Engineering team, you will be required to attend a regional HubSpot office for in-person onboarding. If you join our broader Product team, you’ll also attend other in-person events, such as your Product Group Summit and other gatherings, to continue building on those connections.

title: Vertriebsmitarbeiter/in | Sales Manager - Mittelstand, DACH (Ireland Basierend)
description:
Als Mid-Market Account Executive bei HubSpot arbeitest du direkt mit kleinen und mittelständischen Unternehmen zusammen und unterstützen diese bei ihrem Wachstum. Du nutzt proaktive und Inbound-Verkaufsstrategien, um Interessierte zu finden, neue Kundschaft zu gewinnen und die Nutzung der CRM-Plattform von HubSpot zu steigern. Du setzt dein Wissen über die digitale Transformation und das Change Management ein, um als vertrauenswürdige/r Berater/-in für unsere Kundschaft zu agieren und den Verkaufsprozess von Anfang bis Ende zu begleiten.

Zuständigkeiten eines Account Executive:

Entwicklung und Verwaltung eines jährlichen, vierteljährlichen und monatlichen Geschäftsplan für die eigene Region

Anwerbung neuer Interessierter durch Inbound- und eigene Leads 

Durchführung von Qualifizierungsgesprächen mit Führungskräften der Vorstandsebene und Abteilungsleitenden 

Abschluss von Neugeschäften und Verlängerungen mit einer monatlichen Quote oder darüber

Verkauf über interne Champions an verschiedene Stakeholder sowie direkt an die Führungsetage 

Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing- und IT-Teams zusammenarbeiten, um HubSpots Verkaufsstrategie im Hinblick auf neue Features und Produkte weiterzuentwickeln 

Durchführen von Online- oder Vor-Ort-Demonstrationen unserer Produkte

Voraussetzungen für die Position:

3–5 Jahre Erfahrung in einer zielgebundenen Vertriebsposition

Gute deutsche und englische Sprachkenntnisse

Erfahrung in einer komplexen Vertriebsumgebung 

Erfahrung im Ansprechen von Führungskräften der Vorstandsebene im Hinblick auf einen Wechsel

Erfahrung im Managen einer monatlichen bzw. jährlichen Pipeline und Erstellen präziser Forecasts

Nachgewiesene Übererfüllung der monatlichen und jährlichen Ziele

Ausgebildet und/oder zertifiziert in einer standardisierten Verkaufsmethode (z. B. Sandler)

title: VP, Infrastructure Engineering
description:
Role Summary

Our mission at HubSpot is to help millions of organizations grow better. As VP, Infrastructure Engineering, you'll shape the platforms that make that mission possible by enabling every engineering team to build, deploy, and operate software at scale.

You'll lead an Infrastructure Engineering organization responsible for the cloud platforms, developer experience, data infrastructure, reliability, observability, and engineering productivity capabilities that power HubSpot's products. Reporting to senior engineering leadership, you'll be responsible for defining how infrastructure engineering evolves in an AI-first software company. This is a transformational leadership opportunity to influence HubSpot's technical strategy, accelerate engineering velocity, and help hundreds of engineers deliver remarkable experiences for millions of customers worldwide.

Team Overview

The Infrastructure Engineering organization provides the shared platforms, services, and tooling that every HubSpot product team depends on. From cloud infrastructure and developer platforms to data infrastructure, reliability engineering, observability, and AI-enabled engineering productivity, the team enables product engineers to move faster while delivering secure, reliable, and scalable customer experiences.

What You'll Do

Define and execute the long-term vision for Infrastructure Engineering, ensuring HubSpot's platforms continue to scale with our customers, products, and engineering organization.

Lead and develop a high-performing organization of engineers, building leadership depth and succession across the organization.

Drive the evolution of HubSpot's engineering platforms, including cloud infrastructure, platform as a service, data infrastructure, observability, and reliability engineering.

Lead the transformation of Infrastructure Engineering for an AI-first future by identifying opportunities where AI fundamentally changes how software is built, operated, and supported.

Accelerate global infrastructure expansion while ensuring platform reliability, security, scalability, and operational excellence.

Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Security, and executive leadership to align infrastructure investments with company strategy and product priorities.

Champion modern Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices, operational excellence, and continuous improvements to platform reliability and developer experience.

Drive adoption of scalable platform capabilities that improve engineering velocity while reducing operational complexity.

Foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, inclusion, and customer focus across the Infrastructure Engineering organization.

Build strategic relationships with key technology partners, including hyperscale cloud providers, to maximize long-term platform capabilities and business value.

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

Significant executive engineering leadership experience leading large, multi-layer engineering organizations.

Proven success building and scaling Infrastructure Engineering, Platform Engineering, Developer Platforms, or Cloud Platform organizations within modern cloud-native SaaS businesses.

Experience operating highly available, globally distributed systems serving millions of users or customers at internet scale.

Deep understanding of cloud-native architecture, distributed systems, developer platforms, reliability engineering, observability, infrastructure automation, and modern software delivery.

Demonstrated ability to define long-term technical strategy while delivering measurable business outcomes.

Experience partnering with executive leadership to shape organizational strategy and technology investment decisions.

Strong track record developing engineering leaders, building inclusive organizations, and creating high-performing teams.

Excellent executive communication, organizational leadership, and cross-functional influencing skills.

Passion for leveraging AI to transform engineering, infrastructure, operations, and the entire software lifecycle.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

Experience operationalizing modern database technologies and large-scale data platforms.

Experience building or evolving internal developer platforms that significantly improve engineering productivity.

Experience partnering strategically with AWS, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Azure.

Track record improving cloud efficiency and operational cost optimization at enterprise scale.

Active participation in the broader engineering community through technical writing, speaking, or open-source contributions.

title: Principal Product Manager (Strategic Account Interactions) - Security Solutions
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to be the primary product voice for Elastic Security's most strategic enterprise customers. Solid products are built on a clear knowledge of real customer needs. In large enterprise accounts, those needs arrive as a constant stream of enhancement requests, feature asks, and hard problems. They often arrive faster than any one team can act on them. Someone has to bring order to that stream, tell apart what a customer wants from what a customer needs, and turn it into a coherent product direction across different product areas.

In this high-impact role, you will own the relationship between Elastic Security's product organization and our most strategic enterprise accounts. You will manage enhancement requests across many enterprise customers at once. You will prioritize them with judgment and data, and make sure they keep transitioning through the system instead of sitting idle. You will be the person a CISO trusts in the room, the person an engineering lead respects for the quality of your requirements, and the person who can tell a major customer that something will not be built without losing the relationship. You will work at the intersection of Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Engineering, building the structure that lets Elastic scale close customer relationships without simply adding headcount.

What You Will Be Doing

Own the enhancement request pipeline across multiple strategic enterprise accounts at once. Build and maintain a structured system to track, prioritize, and respond to customer-sourced requirements, and keep requests moving rather than leaving them in “under consideration.”

Translate customer requirements into shipped products. Work at the level of customer pain, not just the feature that was asked for, and synthesize input from many accounts into a single, coherent product direction.

Turn input from strategic accounts into successful products. Look for patterns across accounts. Shape some of these patterns into formal partnerships for design. Make sure the resulting capabilities benefit the wider market, not just the single customer that made the request.

Feed validated customer patterns back into the core product roadmaps, influencing direction well beyond the accounts you cover.

Serve as the primary product voice in meetings with senior customer stakeholders, including the CISO, CTO, and VP of Security Operations. Deliver roadmap updates, including deprioritizations and misses, in a way that keeps the relationship deep.

Prioritize customer-sourced requirements using structured frameworks such as RICE, weighted scoring, and opportunity sizing. Use data where it is available and clear judgment where it is thin, and be transparent about which is which.

Partner with product and engineering leads to write requirements they can act on without follow-up clarification meetings. Understand system architecture well enough to assess feasibility and scope on your own.

Operate across Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Legal. Support deal cycles as a product resource through RFP responses, security questionnaires, and roadmap presentations to prospects.

Navigate tension between a customer's contractual expectations and the internal roadmap, and tackle it directly rather than through routine escalation.

Create artifacts such as roadmap trackers, enhancement request dashboards, and decision memos that give customers and internal stakeholders visibility without requiring a meeting.

Advocate for customer needs inside the company while resisting the pull of the loudest or largest customer setting the roadmap at the expense of the broader market.

What You Bring

Extensive Experience: 7–10 years of product management experience, with at least 4 years in B2B enterprise software. A consistent record of owning a product area with meaningful revenue impact and of leading products from customer input through shipped, iterated outcomes. Direct experience working with named strategic accounts, not only through customer success proxies. Experience with hyperscalers, MSSPs and/or PubSec is a solid plus.

Security Domain Knowledge: Hands-on knowledge with SIEM, SOAR, XDR or broader security operations platforms, either as a product manager or as a practitioner such as a SOC analyst, detection engineer, or security architect. You can credibly discuss detection engineering, log ingestion pipelines, correlation rules, threat hunting workflows, and compliance use cases without a solutions engineer in the room. You understand the difference between what a CISO wants to hear and what a SOC analyst actually needs. A background as a security practitioner, such as SOC, incident response, or detection engineering, before moving into product is a solid plus, and brings credibility that is hard to teach.

Enhancement Request Management at Scale: You have personally run a structured enhancement request pipeline across several enterprise accounts at the same time. You can step into a relationship with dozens of open requests and no prior documentation and build a working tracking system within weeks.

Executive Presence: You are comfortable as the primary product voice with C-suite and VP-level customer stakeholders. You can deliver difficult news without losing the relationship, and you can hold both the executive view and the analyst view in the same meeting.

Technical Credibility: You earn respect from engineering through the quality of your requirements rather than through authority. You write specs engineers can act on, and you know enough about architecture to judge feasibility and scope.

Cross-functional Leadership and Influence: You have operated at the intersection of Product, Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Legal, and you know which function owns what and how to advance work across all of them. You lead across a matrixed organization, align multiple stakeholders toward a common vision, and drive execution in a dynamic, remote-first environment, with the autonomy and judgment expected of a principal-level product leader.

Structured Thinking and Bias for Closure: You bring order to unstructured problems, using data to prioritize and clear judgment when data is thin, and staying transparent about which is which. You move work through the system and follow up proactively rather than waiting to be asked, defaulting to visibility through artifacts instead of meetings. You advocate for customer needs while synthesizing them into product direction rather than relaying demands.

Comfortable with AI-Augmented Work: You use AI tooling for synthesis, documentation, and preparation as a regular part of your workflow, which lets you manage a higher volume of customer context than a pre-AI workflow would allow. You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes. You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities. You can work autonomously, drive decisions and result in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.

Communication Excellence: You have impressive spoken and written communication skills. You can distill complex detection engineering and security operations concepts into clear narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences, including executive management.

Location and Travel

This role is remote-first. Travel up to 50% to support Elastic's most strategic accounts, including on-site executive and design-partner engagements, is expected.

Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary.  This role does not have a variable compensation component.  

At Elastic, our compensation philosophy aims to provide fair, competitive and transparent remuneration. Salary ranges are established based on a combination of external market benchmarks, internal pay equity considerations, and the responsibilities and complexity associated with each role. This approach helps ensure consistency across comparable roles while remaining competitive within the relevant labour markets.

The final compensation offered within the applicable range will be determined based on several objective factors, including relevant professional experience, level of skills and expertise, alignment with the role requirements, and the overall scope and complexity of the position.

The typical starting salary range for this role is:

€80.400—€127.200 EUR

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary

Health coverage for you and your family in many locations

Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles

Generous number of vacation days each year

Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service

Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love

Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.

We welcome individuals with disabilities and strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all individuals. To request an accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email candidate_accessibility@elastic.co. We will reply to your request within 24 business hours of submission.

description:

By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to be the primary product voice for Elastic Security's most strategic enterprise customers. Solid products are built on a clear knowledge of real customer needs. In large enterprise accounts, those needs arrive as a constant stream of enhancement requests, feature asks, and hard problems. They often arrive faster than any one team can act on them. Someone has to bring order to that stream, tell apart what a customer wants from what a customer needs, and turn it into a coherent product direction across different product areas.

In this high-impact role, you will own the relationship between Elastic Security's product organization and our most strategic enterprise accounts. You will manage enhancement requests across many enterprise customers at once. You will prioritize them with judgment and data, and make sure they keep transitioning through the system instead of sitting idle. You will be the person a CISO trusts in the room, the person an engineering lead respects for the quality of your requirements, and the person who can tell a major customer that something will not be built without losing the relationship. You will work at the intersection of Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Engineering, building the structure that lets Elastic scale close customer relationships without simply adding headcount.

What You Will Be Doing

Own the enhancement request pipeline across multiple strategic enterprise accounts at once. Build and maintain a structured system to track, prioritize, and respond to customer-sourced requirements, and keep requests moving rather than leaving them in “under consideration.”

Translate customer requirements into shipped products. Work at the level of customer pain, not just the feature that was asked for, and synthesize input from many accounts into a single, coherent product direction.

Turn input from strategic accounts into successful products. Look for patterns across accounts. Shape some of these patterns into formal partnerships for design. Make sure the resulting capabilities benefit the wider market, not just the single customer that made the request.

Feed validated customer patterns back into the core product roadmaps, influencing direction well beyond the accounts you cover.

Serve as the primary product voice in meetings with senior customer stakeholders, including the CISO, CTO, and VP of Security Operations. Deliver roadmap updates, including deprioritizations and misses, in a way that keeps the relationship deep.

Prioritize customer-sourced requirements using structured frameworks such as RICE, weighted scoring, and opportunity sizing. Use data where it is available and clear judgment where it is thin, and be transparent about which is which.

Partner with product and engineering leads to write requirements they can act on without follow-up clarification meetings. Understand system architecture well enough to assess feasibility and scope on your own.

Operate across Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Legal. Support deal cycles as a product resource through RFP responses, security questionnaires, and roadmap presentations to prospects.

Navigate tension between a customer's contractual expectations and the internal roadmap, and tackle it directly rather than through routine escalation.

Create artifacts such as roadmap trackers, enhancement request dashboards, and decision memos that give customers and internal stakeholders visibility without requiring a meeting.

Advocate for customer needs inside the company while resisting the pull of the loudest or largest customer setting the roadmap at the expense of the broader market.

What You Bring

Extensive Experience: 7–10 years of product management experience, with at least 4 years in B2B enterprise software. A consistent record of owning a product area with meaningful revenue impact and of leading products from customer input through shipped, iterated outcomes. Direct experience working with named strategic accounts, not only through customer success proxies. Experience with hyperscalers, MSSPs and/or PubSec is a solid plus.

Security Domain Knowledge: Hands-on knowledge with SIEM, SOAR, XDR or broader security operations platforms, either as a product manager or as a practitioner such as a SOC analyst, detection engineer, or security architect. You can credibly discuss detection engineering, log ingestion pipelines, correlation rules, threat hunting workflows, and compliance use cases without a solutions engineer in the room. You understand the difference between what a CISO wants to hear and what a SOC analyst actually needs. A background as a security practitioner, such as SOC, incident response, or detection engineering, before moving into product is a solid plus, and brings credibility that is hard to teach.

Enhancement Request Management at Scale: You have personally run a structured enhancement request pipeline across several enterprise accounts at the same time. You can step into a relationship with dozens of open requests and no prior documentation and build a working tracking system within weeks.

Executive Presence: You are comfortable as the primary product voice with C-suite and VP-level customer stakeholders. You can deliver difficult news without losing the relationship, and you can hold both the executive view and the analyst view in the same meeting.

Technical Credibility: You earn respect from engineering through the quality of your requirements rather than through authority. You write specs engineers can act on, and you know enough about architecture to judge feasibility and scope.

Cross-functional Leadership and Influence: You have operated at the intersection of Product, Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Legal, and you know which function owns what and how to advance work across all of them. You lead across a matrixed organization, align multiple stakeholders toward a common vision, and drive execution in a dynamic, remote-first environment, with the autonomy and judgment expected of a principal-level product leader.

Structured Thinking and Bias for Closure: You bring order to unstructured problems, using data to prioritize and clear judgment when data is thin, and staying transparent about which is which. You move work through the system and follow up proactively rather than waiting to be asked, defaulting to visibility through artifacts instead of meetings. You advocate for customer needs while synthesizing them into product direction rather than relaying demands.

Comfortable with AI-Augmented Work: You use AI tooling for synthesis, documentation, and preparation as a regular part of your workflow, which lets you manage a higher volume of customer context than a pre-AI workflow would allow. You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes. You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities. You can work autonomously, drive decisions and result in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.

Communication Excellence: You have impressive spoken and written communication skills. You can distill complex detection engineering and security operations concepts into clear narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences, including executive management.

Location and Travel

title: Principal Product Manager (Strategic Account Interactions) - Security Solutions
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to be the primary product voice for Elastic Security's most strategic enterprise customers. Solid products are built on a clear knowledge of real customer needs. In large enterprise accounts, those needs arrive as a constant stream of enhancement requests, feature asks, and hard problems. They often arrive faster than any one team can act on them. Someone has to bring order to that stream, tell apart what a customer wants from what a customer needs, and turn it into a coherent product direction across different product areas.

In this high-impact role, you will own the relationship between Elastic Security's product organization and our most strategic enterprise accounts. You will manage enhancement requests across many enterprise customers at once. You will prioritize them with judgment and data, and make sure they keep transitioning through the system instead of sitting idle. You will be the person a CISO trusts in the room, the person an engineering lead respects for the quality of your requirements, and the person who can tell a major customer that something will not be built without losing the relationship. You will work at the intersection of Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Engineering, building the structure that lets Elastic scale close customer relationships without simply adding headcount.

What You Will Be Doing

Own the enhancement request pipeline across multiple strategic enterprise accounts at once. Build and maintain a structured system to track, prioritize, and respond to customer-sourced requirements, and keep requests moving rather than leaving them in “under consideration.”

Translate customer requirements into shipped products. Work at the level of customer pain, not just the feature that was asked for, and synthesize input from many accounts into a single, coherent product direction.

Turn input from strategic accounts into successful products. Look for patterns across accounts. Shape some of these patterns into formal partnerships for design. Make sure the resulting capabilities benefit the wider market, not just the single customer that made the request.

Feed validated customer patterns back into the core product roadmaps, influencing direction well beyond the accounts you cover.

Serve as the primary product voice in meetings with senior customer stakeholders, including the CISO, CTO, and VP of Security Operations. Deliver roadmap updates, including deprioritizations and misses, in a way that keeps the relationship deep.

Prioritize customer-sourced requirements using structured frameworks such as RICE, weighted scoring, and opportunity sizing. Use data where it is available and clear judgment where it is thin, and be transparent about which is which.

Partner with product and engineering leads to write requirements they can act on without follow-up clarification meetings. Understand system architecture well enough to assess feasibility and scope on your own.

Operate across Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Legal. Support deal cycles as a product resource through RFP responses, security questionnaires, and roadmap presentations to prospects.

Navigate tension between a customer's contractual expectations and the internal roadmap, and tackle it directly rather than through routine escalation.

Create artifacts such as roadmap trackers, enhancement request dashboards, and decision memos that give customers and internal stakeholders visibility without requiring a meeting.

Advocate for customer needs inside the company while resisting the pull of the loudest or largest customer setting the roadmap at the expense of the broader market.

What You Bring

Extensive Experience: 7–10 years of product management experience, with at least 4 years in B2B enterprise software. A consistent record of owning a product area with meaningful revenue impact and of leading products from customer input through shipped, iterated outcomes. Direct experience working with named strategic accounts, not only through customer success proxies. Experience with hyperscalers, MSSPs and/or PubSec is a solid plus.

Security Domain Knowledge: Hands-on knowledge with SIEM, SOAR, XDR or broader security operations platforms, either as a product manager or as a practitioner such as a SOC analyst, detection engineer, or security architect. You can credibly discuss detection engineering, log ingestion pipelines, correlation rules, threat hunting workflows, and compliance use cases without a solutions engineer in the room. You understand the difference between what a CISO wants to hear and what a SOC analyst actually needs. A background as a security practitioner, such as SOC, incident response, or detection engineering, before moving into product is a solid plus, and brings credibility that is hard to teach.

Enhancement Request Management at Scale: You have personally run a structured enhancement request pipeline across several enterprise accounts at the same time. You can step into a relationship with dozens of open requests and no prior documentation and build a working tracking system within weeks.

Executive Presence: You are comfortable as the primary product voice with C-suite and VP-level customer stakeholders. You can deliver difficult news without losing the relationship, and you can hold both the executive view and the analyst view in the same meeting.

Technical Credibility: You earn respect from engineering through the quality of your requirements rather than through authority. You write specs engineers can act on, and you know enough about architecture to judge feasibility and scope.

Cross-functional Leadership and Influence: You have operated at the intersection of Product, Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Legal, and you know which function owns what and how to advance work across all of them. You lead across a matrixed organization, align multiple stakeholders toward a common vision, and drive execution in a dynamic, remote-first environment, with the autonomy and judgment expected of a principal-level product leader.

Structured Thinking and Bias for Closure: You bring order to unstructured problems, using data to prioritize and clear judgment when data is thin, and staying transparent about which is which. You move work through the system and follow up proactively rather than waiting to be asked, defaulting to visibility through artifacts instead of meetings. You advocate for customer needs while synthesizing them into product direction rather than relaying demands.

Comfortable with AI-Augmented Work: You use AI tooling for synthesis, documentation, and preparation as a regular part of your workflow, which lets you manage a higher volume of customer context than a pre-AI workflow would allow. You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes. You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities. You can work autonomously, drive decisions and result in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.

Communication Excellence: You have impressive spoken and written communication skills. You can distill complex detection engineering and security operations concepts into clear narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences, including executive management.

This role is remote-first. Travel up to 50% to support Elastic's most strategic accounts, including on-site executive and design-partner engagements, is expected.

title: Administrative Assistant IV
description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

We are looking for a resourceful, proactive, and detail-oriented Administrative Assistant to support two Senior Executives on our Engineering Teams. From calendar management and travel planning to coordinating team meetings and events, you will be responsible for making sure the leaders are using their time in the most efficient way possible. 

Reporting to the lead Executive Assistant on the Engineering Team, you will partner with your leaders, collaborate closely with the Affirm Leadership Support Team, and be a valuable team specialist and individual contributor.

What You’ll Do 

Support two Senior Executives with their respective administrative needs

Calendar management, including scheduling meetings and deconflicting existing meetings, often across multiple time zones

Meeting preparation (such as calendar event creation, drafting agendas, creating slide decks, and communicating with meeting attendees in advance of the meeting)

Managing executive schedules to ensure sufficient time for task completion

Attend meetings when requested to manage Zoom, track action items, and follow up with meeting attendees on action items

Event coordination, including team operations for team building events and working onsite/offsite meetings

Build a strong working partnership with the Administrative Assistant supporting the Consumer Engineer Sr. Executives’ Product counterpart to proactively coordinate executive priorities, cross-functional meetings, strategic initiatives, and organizational planning.

Partner with the Leadership Support Team to coordinate needs across the wider Affirm team

Additional administrative functions such as submitting expense reports (via Navan), travel coordination (also via Navan), preparation of documents and presentations (using Google Suite and Microsoft Office), basic team travel and expense budget reconciliation and ad-hoc special projects

Demonstrates curiosity and a growth mindset toward emerging AI technologies, with a commitment to continuously learning and applying AI tools to improve productivity, streamline administrative processes, and enhance support for executives and teams.

Familiarity working with engineering teams is desirable, but not required

What We Look For 

2-4 years of relevant administrative experience

Ability to work independently as well as across various teams

Experience at a rapidly growing company, with the ability to navigate and thrive in a fast-paced dynamic environment

Working knowledge of Google Suite, Microsoft Office, Navan, Zoom

Strong work ethic, professionalism, confidentiality, and good judgment

Ability to deal with conflict as well as give and receive feedback diplomatically

Demonstrates confidence and sound judgment by professionally challenging requests when appropriate, offering thoughtful alternatives, managing expectations, and ensuring decisions align with executive priorities and business objectives.

Highly organized and resourceful, able to juggle and multi-task, with acute attention to detail and follow through

Pay Grade - I
Equity Grade - 3

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $115,000 - $165,000
USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $101,000 - $151,000

Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

LI-Remote

Remote-first with flexibility built in
Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for you
Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.

Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.

Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.

Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

About the Finance team 

The Finance team ensures Affirm remains financially sound and strategically positioned for growth. Our team manages financial planning, accounting, pricing, vendor management, tax, investor relations, and corporate development. We deliver timely insights, accurate reporting, and careful analysis to support decision-making. From day-to-day financial operations to major investments, we enable sustainable, informed growth by maintaining strong fiscal discipline.

About the role

We are looking for a self-motivated and resourceful Bank Head of FP&A to join us during a pivotal moment of growth. As Affirm Bank is currently in its formation phase, we are actively building out our foundational team. Reporting to the Bank CFO, the Bank Head of FP&A will be central to this effort, playing a key role in the formation and operational build-out of the Bank.

The Bank Head of FP&A will play a critical role in building the team and leading day-to-day finance operations. Core responsibilities include managing the forecasting and budget process, developing robust financial models, capital stress testing and monitoring, financial analysis, and partnering with Affirm, Inc. cross-functional teams on financial workflows.

What you'll do

Team Leadership & Talent Development: Build and lead the Bank strategic finance team, providing strategic direction, recruitment, and coaching as we establish the function.

Financial Planning & Analysis: Lead the end-to-end forecasting and budget process, ensuring alignment with organizational goals during this critical startup phase. Perform rigorous financial analysis to inform strategic decision-making.

Financial Modeling: Develop and maintain complex financial models to support strategic planning, scenario analysis, and forecasting for the Bank.

Capital Strategy: Oversee capital stress testing and ongoing monitoring. Partner cross-functionally to validate inputs, pressure-test key drivers, and ensure outputs reflect current business dynamics.

Performance Management & Reporting: Monitor performance against forecasts, diagnose variances, identify root causes, and provide forward-looking insights to drive action.

Strategic Decision Support: Provide decision support on strategic initiatives, evaluating trade-offs and P&L implications. Translate complex analyses into clear, executive-ready narratives that drive insight, inform strategy, and align stakeholders.

Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner closely with Affirm, Inc. cross-functional teams to integrate financial workflows.

Minimum 8+ years relevant experience in analytical roles (e.g., strategic finance, consulting, data science, or analytics), with demonstrated impact on business outcomes

description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the Risk & Analytics Team

The Risk & Analytics (R&A) team makes crucial decisions that direct Affirm’s business strategy. We partner with Machine Learning, Product, Engineering, Capital Markets, and Commercial teams to grow Affirm responsibly by optimizing approval, conversion, losses, and profitability.

Operating across the entire customer and merchant lifecycle, we tackle a diverse array of challenges, from optimizing checkout conversion and mitigating fraud risk to building scalable data foundations and enabling international growth. We analyze performance not just to report on it, but to determine where to invest resources for maximum impact through building tools, scalable data infrastructure, and analytical frameworks.

We improve the analytics experience across Affirm by streamlining workflows and fostering a culture of learning and documentation. By taking ownership of the entire analytical lifecycle, from initial question to final business decision, we turn complex data and systems into clear, actionable signals that ensure Affirm grows efficiently and intelligently.

One Role, Multiple Teams

We are hiring multiple Analyst I roles across Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization through this single job posting. Rather than interviewing for one specific team, candidates will go through a shared interview process designed to assess the core skills we look for across R&A.

If selected, we will work with you to determine the best team match based on your interests, experience, strengths, and current business needs. You will have the opportunity to learn more about our teams and share your preferences as you move through the process.

Potential team placements include:

Point of Sale (POS): Optimize merchant and checkout performance to improve conversion, approvals, and unit economics across the purchase funnel.

Direct to Consumer (DTC) / Card: Drive engagement, repeat usage, and lifecycle health across Affirm's app, web, and card experiences.

Fraud: Prevent and reduce fraud losses across the customer journey while maintaining a frictionless user experience.

Core Analytics: Build the quantitative research, machine learning models, performance monitoring, and scalable data foundations that enable fast, economically sound decisions.

Servicing: Enhance the post-origination customer experience by analyzing repayment behavior, collections strategies, and operational efficiency.

International Expansion: Build the measurement and decision foundations needed to sustainably launch and scale Affirm in new global markets.

About the Role

As an Analyst I in Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization, you will join one of several analytical teams working across the customer and merchant lifecycle. While the specific problems you tackle will depend on your eventual team placement, all Analyst I roles share a common foundation: using data to understand business performance, identify opportunities, and help Affirm make better decisions.

You will learn the fundamentals of consumer lending while executing scoped analytical work under the guidance of senior analysts and managers. You will leverage SQL, Python, and modern analytical tools to help optimize business strategies, monitor performance, and turn complex data into actionable insights.

You are a thoughtful, driven individual eager to build a strong technical foundation, learn how to navigate exogenous market changes, and integrate modern AI tooling to solve hard problems efficiently.

What You Will Do

Derive Insights & Support Strategy: Leverage data analytics to uncover insights that help optimize product, risk, or growth strategies across geographies.

Monitor Portfolio Health: Assist in tracking performance metrics, user behavior, and macroeconomic trends that impact business outcomes, flagging risks and anomalies to senior team members.

Technical Execution: Write clean, working SQL and Python to build scalable reporting and partner with Engineering to support the deployment of machine learning and risk models.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Legal, and Compliance to understand evolving consumer lending regulations and market requirements, assisting in translating them into foundational data models and operational policies.

Drive Launch Alignment: Support cross-functional discussions to ensure new product launches and market entries align with our operational capabilities and risk appetite.

AI Fluency & Efficiency: Integrate AI tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, and copilots into your daily workflows to accelerate data mining and routine tasks, while carefully verifying outputs.

What We Look For

1–3 years of experience in an analytically driven role. Relevant internships or prior experience in consumer lending, fintech, or the broader financial services industry are highly valued.

Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative field.

Solid working knowledge of SQL, Python, or other scripting languages.

Familiarity with data mining, data visualization, and foundational statistical modeling.

Basic understanding of, or deep curiosity about, consumer lending regulations, fair lending principles, and how machine learning techniques apply to real-world business problems.

Exceptional communication skills, humility, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional peers.

We’re looking for a curious, driven professional to join our Revenue Analytics team. This builds and owns the data products, reporting infrastructure, semantic foundations, and analytical systems that power Affirm’s Revenue organization.
As a Senior Analyst, Revenue Analytics, you’ll build scalable data products that power day-to-day decision-making - owning end-to-end work across data modeling, metric definitions, dashboards, automation, and enablement. 
You’ll also help strengthen our semantic layer and data governance, laying the foundation for reliable AI. The ideal candidate combines strong technical and analytical skills with the ability to turn ambiguous business questions into durable, well-tested data infrastructure.

What you'll do 

Develop dbt data models, dashboards, metrics, and automation processes for the revenue field team and revenue analysts

Build and maintain critical reporting data models that power external merchant reporting 

Build the semantic, metadata, and context layers that allow AI systems to accurately understand Revenue data, metrics, and business definitions

Partner with Business Systems, engineering, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into durable, well-tested data products

Contribute to the team’s best practices in version control, code review, documentation, and release hygiene (GitHub-based workflows)

Develop processes, governance, and foundations to scale the impact of analytics within Revenue.

What we look for 

3+ years of work experience in an analytics engineering or business intelligence role

Strong working knowledge of SQL, dbt, Python, data modeling, and data visualization 

Hands-on experience with BI tools (Sigma/Looker/Tableau), Databricks, and cloud data warehouses (Snowflake)

Understanding of the data foundations required for reliable AI, including semantic layers, metadata, evals, metric definitions, documentation, and data quality

Demonstrated experience integrating AI tools into day-to-day analytics engineering workflows to improve development speed, quality, and scalability

Familiarity with Salesforce and experience supporting commercial areas of the business

Ability to identify user needs and translate them into robust, scalable data products

Ability to start with an ambiguous problem, deconstruct it into tangible steps, and work toward an impactful solution

Ability to communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Total rewards

We believe the people building honest financial products at Affirm should share in its success. That's why our total rewards are designed to support your health, growth, financial well-being, and future.

In service of our mission, we reward employees through a combination of base pay, equity (from parent company), and comprehensive benefits.

Base Pay Grade - K
226 000 zł  -  346 000 zł      

Base pay ranges and placement within those ranges are determined based on several factors, including role, experience, and job-related skills.

In addition to base pay, all employees in this role are eligible to receive equity from the parent company each year. This means as Affirm’s parent company grows, employees have the opportunity to share in that growth financially.

In addition to your compensation, our comprehensive benefits are designed to support you and the people who matter most. Benefits include:

Competitive paid time off, paid public holidays, and additional paid Away Days to rest and recharge.

Comprehensive private healthcare through Lux Med's Platinum package.

A MultiSport card to support your health and well-being.

Learning and development programs to help you grow professionally. 

Family healthcare support through Maven and parental leave support through Parentaly.

Financial well-being support through Northstar, with unlimited access to Certified Financial Advisors and planning tools at no cost to you.

Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that foster connection and inclusion.

Eligibility for creative tax benefits, subject to applicable law, role, and company policy.

title: Analytics Lead, Deposit Fraud Risk
description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

The Fraud team at Affirm Bank works cross-functionally with Machine Learning, Product, Engineering, Operations to combat fraudulent activities to foster a safe platform. 

This role requires abundant cross-functional partnership. This individual will be the representative of the Credit Risk org, leading the charge on refining our Identity Verification and Fraud processes as well as our Application flow. Additionally, this role will work closely with the Product and Engineering teams to improve our Fraud solution. 

Come join us in our mission to change consumer finance through better technology, lower costs, and increased transparency while providing the best customer experience.  

What You'll Do

This role will take charge of owning fraud performance for depository products, including monitoring fraud losses, approval rates, false positives, customer friction, and other key risk metrics 

Data Pipeline, Analytics & Monitoring

Build and maintain scalable data models and transformation pipelines, using tools (such as DBT) to standardize depository product, transaction, customer, fraud, and operational data.

Define trusted fraud performance metrics and analytical datasets, including fraud loss rates, approval and decline rates, false-positive rates, customer friction, and operational efficiency.

Develop recurring dashboards, scorecards, and monitoring frameworks to provide clear visibility into fraud performance, portfolio health, and emerging risks.

Conduct deep-dive analyses to diagnose fraud losses, control gaps, false positives, portfolio shifts, and unexpected performance changes, translating findings into actionable recommendations.

Fraud Strategy Building & Optimization

Develop and optimize fraud rules, policies, thresholds, models, and decision strategies that balance loss prevention, customer experience, operational capacity, and product growth.

Evaluate new data sources and signals to improve detection of identity risk, account takeover, device risk, transaction risk, and other fraud typologies relevant to depository products.

Lead testing and performance measurement of fraud strategy changes, including rule launches, model updates, policy changes, and new product controls, with clear pre- and post-implementation evaluation.

Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Machine Learning, Data Engineering, Fraud Operations, and Risk to improve fraud strategies, strengthen operational feedback loops, and support new product launches.

What We Look For

EXPERIENCE - 7+ years’ of Analytics experience

PRODUCT KNOWLEDGE - Passion to understand how Affirm product works and a curious mindset to help change and make it more effective

TECHNICAL SKILLS - Fluent in SQL and Python

PEOPLE SKILLS - A team player with ability to collaborate and influence across many different teams in the organization

COMMUNICATION - Ability to communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

EXECUTION - Able to thrive in a fast-paced environment and be responsive and available during times of peak fraud activity

MULTI-TASKING - Strong time management skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities

RISK KNOWLEDGE  - Working knowledge of the fundamentals of payment processing and an understanding of industry risk trends, including familiarity with fraud strategy development 

We also encourage you to read our Chief Risk Officer’s views on what makes Credit Risk Managers influential and on a Modern Risk Management System.

Equity Grade -  USA 8

title: Analytics Lead, Full Stack
description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

We are seeking a highly motivated and analytical individual to join our Growth Analytics International team. This team plays a crucial role in conducting research, monitoring performance, and running experiments to develop exceptional products for both consumers and merchants while driving long-term growth for the business. As Affirm continues expanding into new international markets, this role will be instrumental in establishing the operational analytics framework for new launches, beginning with Australia and expanding into future international markets. The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, a collaborative mindset, an eagerness to learn, and the patience to tackle complex challenges.

Our team takes an end-to-end business analytics perspective, partnering across the organization to develop recommendations and solutions that enable the business to successfully execute its growth and profitability strategies. This role requires someone who can combine analytical rigor with business acumen to influence decisions and drive measurable outcomes.

What you’ll do

Establish and evolve the operational analytics framework for new international markets, ensuring scalable measurement, reporting, and decision-making capabilities as we expand globally.

Operate with a business owner mindset by proactively identifying opportunities through analysis and product sense to enhance user experience, growth, and profitability.

Own business problems from end to end by translating analytical insights into recommendations and optimization strategies that support business growth, profitability, and operational excellence.

Take ownership of the end-to-end analytics process: define success metrics, generate insights and hypotheses, track performance, and create intuitive dashboards and reports that can be easily shared across the organization. Develop scalable analytics solutions and data models.

Tackle ambiguous problems by identifying the core hypotheses and designing actionable experiments to validate product-market fit and economic viability.

Translate analytical findings into clear and compelling narratives and business cases for leadership to inform decision-making.

Spearhead weekly cross-functional metric reviews, collaborating with partners to conduct deep dives into significant metric shifts and suggest actionable steps.

Partner effectively across Product, Risk, Finance, Commercial, and Operations to align strategies and execute against business objectives.

Foster strong cross-functional relationships and establish yourself as a trusted advisor to team members.

Mentor and guide junior analysts to deliver high-impact work that drives business results.

What we look for:

Passion to redefine the lending and financial industry for the better.

Strong understanding of the consumer lending and credit industry, including lending economics, portfolio performance, and credit metrics. Experience supporting international lending markets, particularly Europe and/or APAC, is highly desirable.

Demonstrated ability to balance growth objectives with profitability and develop data-driven growth strategies.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitatively rigorous subject area such as statistics, mathematics, finance, or economics.

5+ years of proven success in a cross-functional analytical role.

Practical and theoretical knowledge of A/B testing.

Experience with SQL and performing statistical analysis using Python.

Experience simultaneously balancing multiple workstreams and prioritizing an analytics roadmap.

Demonstrated curiosity and a growth mindset, with hands-on experience using AI-powered tools such as Cursor, Claude, or similar assistants to accelerate analysis, automate workflows, enhance problem-solving, and advocate for AI adoption across analytical workflows.

Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical audiences.

Comfortable partnering across multiple cross-functional teams, particularly Product, Risk, Commercial, Finance, and Operations.

Ability to think creatively and critically while thriving in a fast-paced, dynamic, and often ambiguous work environment.

Willingness to go out of your way to help teammates, with humility and a team-first mindset.

Previous experience mentoring and guiding junior analysts.

Compensation & Benefits
