 - Margin Modeling & Methodology

   - Ongoing performance monitoring of initial and variation margin models across cleared products, including futures, options, and swaps.

   - Lead periodic recalibration of margin parameters (lookback windows, volatility scaling, anti-procyclicality measures, liquidity add-ons, concentration charges) and document changes in accordance with the DCO’s model governance framework.

   - Evaluate and enhance portfolio-based margining methodologies (e.g., SPAN-style, VaR/Expected Shortfall, filtered historical simulation) for accuracy, defensibility, and regulatory compliance.

   - Conduct back-testing, sensitivity analysis, and model performance reviews; clearly articulate findings to internal stakeholders, the Risk Committee, and regulators.

   Market Risk & Stress Testing

   - Design, execute, and continuously refine the DCO’s stress testing program, including historical, hypothetical, and reverse stress scenarios.

   - Monitor market risk exposures of clearing members and the clearinghouse as a whole, including concentration, wrong-way risk, liquidity risk, and tail-risk exposures.

   - Assess the adequacy of the default waterfall, guaranty fund sizing, and skin-in-the-game contributions in light of evolving market conditions.

   - Produce daily, weekly, and monthly risk reporting to senior management, the Risk Committee, and external regulators.

   Regulatory & Governance

   - Ensure ongoing compliance with CFTC Part 39 DCO Core Principles, including those governing financial resources, margin, risk management, default procedures, and system safeguards.

   - Serve as a liaison to the CFTC and other regulators during examinations, rule certifications, and ad hoc inquiries.

   - Maintain robust model risk management documentation aligned with industry standards and the DCO’s internal governance policies.

   - Support the Chief Risk Officer in Risk Committee preparation, member due diligence, and the evaluation of new products and clearing services.

   Clearing Member Oversight

   - Conduct financial and operational risk reviews of clearing members, including assessment of capital adequacy, liquidity, and risk management practices.

   - Monitor intraday and end-of-day exposures, margin calls, and collateral sufficiency; escalate emerging risks to the CRO and senior leadership.

   - Partner with operations and technology to enhance real-time risk monitoring tools and dashboards.

WHAT YOU BRING

 - Minimum of 10 years of risk management experience at a CFTC-registered DCO, with direct ownership of margin and/or stress testing methodologies.

 - Deep, practical knowledge of CFTC regulations, particularly Part 39 DCO Core Principles, and familiarity with adjacent rules under Parts 1, 22, and 190.

 - Demonstrated expertise in market risk concepts: VaR, Expected Shortfall, scenario analysis, volatility modeling, and portfolio risk aggregation across futures and options.

 - Foundation in margin model design and validation (SPAN, SPAN 2, historical simulation, parametric, or Monte Carlo-based approaches).

 - Hands-on experience designing and executing stress testing programs that meet DCO regulatory expectations (liquidity stress, default management drills).

 - Bachelor’s degree required in a quantitative discipline (Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or related field); advanced degree (Master’s) preferred.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with proven ability to present complex risk concepts to executives, board members, and regulators.

 - Sound judgment under pressure, with the ability to make defensible risk decisions in volatile markets.

 - Intellectual rigor and attention to detail in model design, validation, and documentation.

 - Collaborative orientation across risk, operations, technology, compliance, and legal functions.

 - Comfort engaging directly with regulators, clearing members, and senior internal stakeholders.

NICE TO HAVES

 - Prior experience at a Futures Commission Merchant (FCM), including familiarity with customer segregation requirements, house vs. customer margining, and FCM risk management practices.

 - Experience with cleared derivatives across multiple asset classes (digital assets, interest rates, energy, agricultural, metals, equity indices, FX).

 - Working knowledge of default management processes, including auction protocols, hedging, and porting of customer positions.

 - Experience supporting regulatory examinations, rule filings, or new product self-certifications under CFTC Part 40.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Model Risk Management Specialist to join our team, focusing on Transaction Monitoring and Customer Risk Assessments models for Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Combating the Financing of Terrorism (CFT) purposes. The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring that our Transaction Monitoring, Customer Risk Assessment and Screening models are robust, effective, and compliant with regulatory requirements.

 - Model Validation: perform independent validation of Transaction Monitoring / Customer Risk Assessment / Screening models, AI models (built in Claude or ChatGPT), including but not limited to:

   - Reviewing model pre & post development documentation, data quality, accuracy, access and testing methodologies.

   - Assessing model performance, accuracy, and stability.

   - Evaluating model risk and identifying potential biases.

   - Reviewing AI Models for AML/CFT Program

 - AML/CFT Regulatory Compliance: ensure that Transaction Monitoring and Customer Risk Assessment models comply with relevant AML/CFT regulations, including but not limited to:

   - EU AML/CFT Directives.

   - US BSA/AML regulations.

   - FATF recommendations.

 - Risk Assessment: conduct risk assessments to identify potential AML/CFT risks associated with Transaction Monitoring and Customer Risk Assessment models, including but not limited to:

   - Identifying higher-risk customer segments, products, and geographies.

   - Assessing the effectiveness of controls and mitigants.

 - Model Monitoring and Maintenance: develop and implement procedures for ongoing model monitoring and maintenance, including but not limited to:

   - Annual reporting & certification

   - Tracking model performance and identifying degradation.

   - Conducting regular model reviews and updates.

 - Collaboration and Communication: collaborate with various stakeholders, including but not limited to:

   - Model Engineering and owners.

   - AML/CFT subject matter experts.

   - Business units and risk management teams.

 - Documentation and Reporting: prepare and maintain high-quality documentation, including but not limited to:

   - Model validation reports.

   - Risk assessments.

   - Regulatory compliance reports.

 - Methodology Development: contribute to the development and maintenance of model validation methodologies, including but not limited to:

   - Developing and refining model validation frameworks.

   - Identifying best practices and industry standards.

WHAT YOU BRING

 - Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (e.g., mathematics, statistics, computer science, engineering).

 - 5+ years of experience in model validation, risk management, or a related field, preferably in AML/CFT.

 - Understanding of international Model Risk Management rules and regulations, such as OCC SR 11-7.

 - Strong understanding of machine learning and statistical modeling techniques.

 - Deep understanding of fiat and crypto payment flows

 - Proficiency in programming languages (e.g., Python, R, SQL).

 - Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).

 - Strong understanding of financial markets, products, and services.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

NICE TO HAVES

 - Professional certifications (e.g., FRM, CDA, CAP).

 - Experience with AML/CFT transaction monitoring and Customer Risk Assessment systems

 - Knowledge of cloud-based technologies.

 - Experience with agile development methodologies.

The Pro Verifications team decides whether a business signing up on the Pro side is who it says it is, and whether we're allowed to onboard it. That means figuring out who actually owns the business, running it against sanctions and watchlists, and doing all of it fast enough that a real customer doesn't lose patience and leave. Every Pro customer hits these systems, so slow or wrong is very visible — and the team is early, which means whoever joins gets to decide how a lot of it works instead of inheriting it.

How We Work

 - We deploy constantly, almost always behind a flag, in pieces small enough to pull back fast.

 - Security and compliance show up at design time, not as a gate at the end.

 - Every story is tied to a metric it's meant to move — if work isn't on the board, it doesn't get staffed.

 - At this level, you're expected to shape these standards, not just work inside them.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As a Staff Engineer on Pro Verifications, you'll own the technical direction for how verification is built here — the architecture, the patterns other engineers work inside, and the calls about what we own versus what we lean on a vendor for. You'll be hands-on across the stack, drive out entire classes of recurring failure rather than patching them one at a time, and design the fail-closed and audit behavior that keeps regulators satisfied.

This is a high-impact, hands-on technical leadership role for engineers who've built where being wrong has real consequences, and who want to shape a system that stays fast, safe, and defensible as it grows.

 - Set the shape of the verification services and their contracts across the KYC/KYB flow.

 - Decide how we abstract KYC and KYB vendors so a bad provider day doesn't turn into an outage.

 - Design fail-closed behavior and audit trails that hold up under regulatory scrutiny.

 - Identify the classes of failure that keep recurring and remove them for good.

 - Write and drive architecture decisions (ADRs), and hold the line on security and compliance at design time, not as a late gate.

 - Mentor and raise the bar for senior engineers through design reviews, code, and direct feedback.

 - Be measured on whether verification gets faster, more of it decides itself, fewer decisions are wrong, and the systems stay up — and on whether the team got stronger for you being on it.

WHAT YOU BRING

 - Around eight years building and running production systems, with a track record of owning a domain's technical direction, not just delivering inside one.

 - Deep, fluent expertise in Rust, with the versatility to work across TypeScript and React where verification meets the customer.

 - You've set architecture other people build on, and it held up — you can point to specific classes of failure you designed out, not just incidents you fixed.

 - You've made teams faster through patterns, tooling, or mentoring — engineers around you got better and shipped more because of calls you made.

 - You've built where being wrong had real consequences: compliance, payments, security, or anywhere a bad call costs more than a rough user experience.

 - Strong on distributed systems, service contracts, and secure design — you've integrated third-party APIs that couldn't be trusted, with real timeouts, retries, idempotency, circuit breakers, and backup paths that actually get tested.

 - Comfortable with, or able to quickly ramp on, gRPC, Temporal, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, MySQL/MariaDB, Redis, and GitLab CI.

Kraken's Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Our disciplines cover performance ad creative, static and 3D design, motion design, AI video creative and web design, turning growth strategy into creative that converts across paid, owned and organic surfaces. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, holding the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As our Senior Performance Creative, you concept, produce and ship paid creative for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Paid static is the center of the role, but we're hiring a hybrid rather than a specialist: this means you also ideate and create performance video and treat gen AI as a core production method rather than a novelty. You take a project from idea to a finished, approved, multi-market asset set, and you bring a real feel for what people stop on, share and screenshot.

You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. Senior here means craft and automation leadership: you set the bar for paid static on the team, work with AI enabled processes, collaborate closely with other Krakenites in and outside the team, and are the person others come to with performance creative questions.

 - Own paid static for Kraken Consumer across product launches, campaigns, promotions and always-on activity.

 - Build for channels like Meta, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit and X. You know what wins where, and you build to each platform's specs and native feel.

 - Concept and cut performance video so campaigns ship as complete cross-format sets, from 9:16 sound-on to static-adjacent 1:1 and 4:5.

 - Produce AI-generated and AI-assisted video and imagery, and know when AI is the fastest route to a great ad and when it isn't.

 - Bring ideas to briefs rather than executing them literally. Pitch culturally timely, internet-native concepts that nobody asked for, and build the winners into creative pillars we can keep using.

 - Version and localize at scale across markets, languages, formats and regulatory requirements. In a typical month you'll have roughly a dozen workstreams in flight at once, most spanning several formats and several markets.

 - Build creative that's designed to be tested. Performance Marketing owns test design, cadence and readouts. You own the creative response: reading the results, forming a point of view on why a variant won, and turning that into the next round of hooks, concepts and cuts.

 - Partner with Product Marketing, compliance and regional teams to get work approved without losing the idea.

 - Hold a high craft bar on your own work and keep your files clean enough for other people to build on.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - 5+ years in performance creative at a high-volume in-house team or performance agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category.

 - A portfolio that proves it, submitted with your application. Paid static above all, with the brief or objective alongside the work and the result where you're able to share it. Include two or three full video cuts, at least one AI-generated or AI-assisted piece with a short note on what was tooling and what was you, and one concept you tested where you can talk us through what the data said and what you changed.

 - Layout, hierarchy, type and composition that hold up at thumbnail size, in feed, and in multiple languages.

 - Platform-native instincts across Meta, TikTok and YouTube. You can explain why the same idea needs a different build on each one.

 - Real video skills, from concept to finished, sound-designed cut.

 - High-level command of gen AI video and image tooling, with shipped work to show for it.

 - Experience inside a structured creative testing program. You're fluent in the metrics your creative moves (thumb-stop rate, hook rate, CTR, CVR, CPA and ROAS), you can tell a real winner from low performers, and can translate test results into a creative decision.

 - Fluency in internet and meme culture, with comedic timing and an instinct for what's about to feel dated.

 - Speed without sloppiness. Comfortable with fast turnarounds, several review rounds and late changes.

 - Comfort working inside regulatory constraints, with layouts that survive risk warnings and market-specific requirements.

 - A solid copywriting instinct. Plain language, value first, no hype and no jargon.

 - Figma and Adobe CC (After Effects, Premiere, Photoshop) as well as strong genAI skills

title: AI Platform Engineer, Enablement and Governance Operations
description:
BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout,  xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page https://www.kraken.com/culture to understand what drives us and how we work.

THE TEAM

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Enterprise Transformation owns Kraken's internal AI platform. AI tooling is deployed at scale across the org. Tiered spend controls are live, a governed integration gateway is in production, and a system inventory is being built against real regulatory obligations. The next constraint is not access. It's capability. The frontier moves every few weeks, and most of what arrives is a protocol, API, or primitive that someone has to turn into something the rest of the company can safely use.

THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Design and build the technical layer of the AI platform, from integration surface to production runbook. Identify capability gaps between what's possible and what the organization can safely use, then close them by evaluating vendors or building internally.

 - Own the governed integration gateway as an engineering surface. You'll handle connector onboarding, authentication flows including OAuth and federated identity, reliability, and vendor escalation when things break.

 - Build internal tooling that extends the platform. Think agent scaffolding, reusable skills and prompt assets, evaluation harnesses for model changes, provisioning automation, and integrations between AI tooling and your systems of record.

 - Configure and operate tiered spend controls across the AI estate. Set caps by role and tier, build alerting rules, manage exception queues, run monthly reconciliation against vendor commitments, and eliminate the current single author risk in cap automation.

 - Implement the technical controls behind policy on data handling, retention, and model eligibility. This means identity integration, SSO and SCIM, entitlement by role and tier, and workspace configuration where retention terms differ by model class.

 - Work directly with teams to unblock them. Sit with them, understand the workflow, build or configure the thing that enables them to get real leverage from the tools.

 - Run technical enablement. Deep dives for tool rollouts, office hours for model releases, and authority over the engineering detail in knowledge base material.

 - Administer the enterprise AI estate end to end. Model turn ups, feature enablement, deprecation, provisioning queue, vendor configurations, and seat true ups.

WHAT YOU BRING

 - Enterprise SaaS administration at 1,000+ seats, ideally including an AI or LLM platform.

 - Demonstrated ability to build and ship working software, not just configure vendor products. Python or a comparable language should be natural to you. Version control, CI, containers, and secrets management are everyday tools.

 - Experience integrating against LLM and SaaS APIs with working familiarity of agent and tool use patterns, including MCP or equivalent tool calling architectures.

 - You write fast and well. Short-form that lands, long-form that holds up under scrutiny from people smarter than the average follower.

 - You have thick skin and good instincts. Crypto community management means getting yelled at with an audience watching. You de-escalate without going corporate and you know when to push back.

 - You've built something from a standing start, not just maintained an existing account.

 - You operate without a brief. Markets don't wait for approval chains, and neither should you… because you know where the line is and you don't need a committee to find it.

We're looking for a Data Analyst, Regulatory Analytics and Reporting to join our team remotely! The #1 goal of this role is to turn complex compliance and regulatory data into clear, actionable insights that protect the business, satisfy regulators, and support senior leadership in making high-stakes decisions. You'll work at the intersection of data engineering, regulatory reporting, and compliance operations in a fast-paced, high-scrutiny environment where accuracy and audit-readiness are non-negotiable.

Beyond technical expertise, success in this role depends on being a true business partner who combines data-driven insights with deep knowledge of compliance regulations and frameworks. You'll own end-to-end data management from building and maintaining datasets and pipelines to designing dashboards and insights for compliance and leadership teams. You will also automate compliance processes and workflows to boost efficiency and minimize human error.

If you combine exceptional data analysis expertise with solid knowledge of compliance regulations, a keen eye for regulatory risk, and the drive to shape the future of crypto with a top-tier brand - this is your next mission!

THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Own the design of dashboards, compliance metrics, and regulatory reports, turning data into actionable insights for stakeholders, cross-functional partners, and regional compliance officers

 - Automate end to end compliance related data solutions, governance controls, and automations to boost efficiency and minimize manual intervention

 - Dive into large, complex datasets to turn findings into scalable, audit-ready data models that facilitate regulatory reporting and analytics

 - Translate regulatory and business requests into accurate reports and automated data pipelines using Python, SQL, DBT and Airflow

 - Lead cross-functional projects with analysts, engineers, and compliance teams to build and maintain high-quality data pipelines and sources

 - Coordinate client data quality monitoring by identifying issues, flagging remediations, and partnering with responsible teams to ensure timely resolution

 - Support ad-hoc data requests for audits, exams, risk assessments, and day-to-day business needs

 - Deliver insights that shape compliance direction through clear, data-driven storytelling

WHAT YOU BRING

 - 5+ years of experience in data analysis and data management within financial services or a regulated industry, with hands-on experience in compliance and regulatory reporting across frameworks such as AML, KYC, Sanctions, MiCA, or MiFID

 - Solid understanding of regulatory risk and the ability to operate effectively in high-scrutiny, audit-ready environments

 - Expert SQL skills including complex joins, CTEs, and analytical functions, paired with proficiency in Python libraries such as pandas, matplotlib, and plotly

 - Hands-on experience using dbt or similar tooling to model and organize high fidelity data for reporting and decision-making

 - Experience setting up and managing data pipelines with a strong understanding of data workflow orchestration

 - Proficiency with BI and data visualization tools such as QuickSight, Power BI, or Superset to build executive-facing dashboards

 - Strong communicator who can simplify complex data ideas for both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Alignment with the values outlined in Kraken's Tentaclements document

NICE TO HAVES

 - Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Information Systems, or a related technical field

 - Passion for continuous learning and approaching problems with a beginner's mindset

 - Solid understanding of the cryptocurrency space and how financial markets function

 - Own the connective tissue between marketing and product at Kraken Consumer — a remit with real scope to shape how millions of people discover and return to our products.

 - Build something from the ground up: the roadmap, the intake model and the standards for how marketing and product work together are all yours to define.

 - Sit at the centre of the acquisition funnel, where small improvements in conversion compound into meaningful growth.

 - Unlock new acquisition channels by building the product surfaces they depend on — paid social, search, affiliates and offline campaigns.

 - Shape a fast-growing mobile acquisition motion, including in-product social, creator partnerships, community and friend-referral mechanics.

 - Own both halves of the lifecycle: bringing new users in, and giving existing users compelling reasons to come back.

 - Work in one of the most competitive corners of consumer fintech, where conversion craft and product quality genuinely decide who wins.

 - Design and launch tailored campaign experiences — the in-app and web journeys users land in from push, email, social and paid.

 - Raise the bar on lifecycle messaging so push and email feel useful rather than noisy, and convert accordingly.

 - Own the incentives layer for new and returning users: offers, referral mechanics, recurring deposits and earn-led campaigns.

 - Apply user psychology and sharp UX thinking to find where the funnel leaks, then run the experiments that close the gaps.

 - Improve landing page and search performance, and build the product foundations that make paid and offline channels measurable and worth the spend.

 - Partner with marketing, design, engineering and data as the single point of ownership for growth enablement.

title: Product Manager II - Financial Crime Operations
description:
BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout,  xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

THE TEAM

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken's Compliance Operations teams, including the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU), investigations and enhanced due diligence, are the front line of how Kraken detects and responds to financial crime. The systems they run on sit within Core Services Product, alongside the engineering teams who build them. That covers alert ingestion, case management, investigator tooling and a growing set of automation and AI tools.

This role owns the product for that investigation platform. That means how an alert is created, enriched, grouped and suppressed. How it becomes a case. How an investigator reaches and documents a decision. And how every step is evidenced to a regulator or auditor. You'll start with the FIU, where the workflows are most complex and the audit bar is highest, then extend the platform across Compliance Operations.

THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Own the investigation-platform roadmap end to end. Sequence it and defend it, and re-sequence it when a regulator or the RCO raises a P0.

 - Define "done" before build starts. Write phased deliverables and acceptance criteria that Compliance signs off, and hold the line when scope moves.

 - Get requirements in before engineering starts. Build the intake between Compliance policy, monitoring rules and case management so that changes don't reach investigators before their workflows are ready.

 - Understand the process before building. Reconcile policy and SOPs against what investigators actually do and what the system actually does. Know the difference between a process fix and a technical one, and say which requests are in scope for engineering.

 - Understand the pipeline well enough to challenge it: ingestion, profile and transaction resolution, suppression and grouping logic, and reconciliation between vendor output and case management. Be able to walk an auditor through it with live examples.

 - Make auditability a first-class requirement: audit trail, data lineage, evidence retention, reviewer attribution, change-management controls, and validation of filtering and suppression logic.

 - Ship automation and AI into regulated workflows with controls that hold up in Compliance, IT and privacy audits. That means human-in-the-loop design, explainability and ongoing monitoring.

 - Run the operating rhythm: a shared forum with engineering and adjacent product managers, a regular stakeholder update, and one delivery status that everyone reads the same way.

WHAT YOU BRING

 - 4+ years of product management, including 2+ years on financial-crime systems such as transaction monitoring, investigations, case management, KYC/EDD or sanctions screening.

 - Working knowledge of how an AML programme is examined, including the questions regulators, internal audit and model validation ask about monitoring, filing and control systems.

 - The technical fluency to go deep on data flows and system design with engineers, and to spot when a design won't meet the requirement.

 - A track record of shipping internal tools or operational platforms that measurably changed how an operations team works.

 - Clear, concise writing, from PRDs and phase plans to audit walkthroughs and executive updates.

 - The judgement to tell a senior stakeholder a timeline isn't realistic because the requirements aren't written yet, and to keep the relationship intact.

NICE TO HAVES

 - Direct FIU experience, such as alert disposition, SAR/STR filing or leading investigators.

 - Crypto or digital-asset experience, such as blockchain analytics, wallet-level transaction analysis or focal vs counterparty logic.

 - Experience shipping AI or ML into a regulated investigative workflow, including the control design.

 - Build-vs-buy and vendor evaluation for monitoring or case-management tooling.

 - Experience with programmes that span jurisdictions (UK, EU/MiCA, US).

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page https://www.kraken.com/culture to understand what drives us and how we work.

THE TEAM

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken's VIP team supports the firm's highest-value private clients; high-net-worth individuals (HNWIs) who expect a premium, secure, and highly tailored experience. We ensure Kraken remains the exchange of choice for VIPs by delivering white-glove relationship management, personalized trading enablement, and high-impact benefits.

We are looking for a Senior VIP Relationship Manager, Asia to help us scale our VIP client book and growth across the region. This is a hybrid role: part white-glove relationship management, part growth and business development; building Kraken and Payward's presence inside Asia's VIP trading and investor communities, running local marketing and events, and sourcing new whale relationships.

We're looking for someone who isn't afraid to be bold, can build and scale initiatives from the ground up, and is humble enough to fail fast and move on to the next challenge. If you thrive in ambiguity and can operate in a fast-paced, scrappy environment, this role is for you.

THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Serve as the trusted point of contact for Kraken's top private clients across Asia, delivering consistent, high-quality white-glove service and building deep, durable relationships.

 - Own the regional VIP book end to end: onboarding, tier progression, retention, and proactive intervention on at-risk and lapsing clients.

 - Drive AOP growth and net deposits as your primary KPIs: notional asset growth, alongside revenue and trading volume.

 - Bring Kraken's private client and VIP offerings to market locally, including yield and earn campaigns, lending against tokenized equities and crypto collateral, OTC execution, and structured private-client benefits; ensuring they remain impactful and competitive against regional exchanges and desks.

 - Source and convert new whale relationships through direct outreach, referral, and introducer networks; family offices, proprietary trading firms, OTC desks, miners, project treasuries, and high-volume individual traders.

 - Get inside Asia's VIP trading communities: private trading groups, investor clubs, KOL and trader networks, WeChat/Telegram/LINE ecosystems, and closed-door investor circles. Be the Kraken face those communities know and trust.

 - Design and run local marketing and events (VIP dinners, trader meetups, conference-adjacent programming, and co-marketing with regional partners and KOLs) in partnership with Kraken's Marketing and Regional teams.

 - Build and manage introducer and referral partnerships that produce a repeatable pipeline of qualified private clients.

 - Act as Kraken's ear on the ground: competitive intelligence on regional exchanges, product gaps that cost us whale business, and the local narratives that move capital.

 - Partner with Product, Marketing, Compliance, Banking and Client Service to champion new efforts that drive private client growth and loyalty; and to make sure every play you run is inside Kraken's licensing and compliance perimeter.

WHAT YOU BRING

 - 5+ years of experience in relationship management, account management, private banking, brokerage, or private client sales, including at least 2 years in the crypto space, with a track record of working with high-net-worth individuals (HNWIs).

 - An existing, personal network among Asia's crypto HNWIs, traders, family offices, OTC desks, funds, or trading communities in Greater China, Hong Kong, Taiwan or Singapore. This is the single most important qualification for this role.

 - Native or near-native Mandarin plus fluent English required. Cantonese is a strong plus.

 - Demonstrated ability to originate business, not just service it; you have personally brought in clients, run events, or built a community presence that produced measurable pipeline.

 - Deep understanding of trading product solutions, including spot, margin, and futures trading, as well as OTC trading, lending, and yield/earn products. Familiarity with how deposits and client balances drive an exchange's lending economics is a strong plus.

 - Comfort operating in a regulated environment across multiple Asian jurisdictions, and the judgment to know when to involve Compliance early.

 - Highly data-driven, with expertise in analyzing KPIs such as assets on platform, net deposits, client portfolio revenue, and trading volume.

 - Ability to be scrappy, bold, and unafraid to explore alternative and creative solutions to achieve results.

 - You bring deep knowledge of cryptocurrency ecosystems, their players, frameworks, and market dynamics beyond just blue-chip tokens.

 - Skilled at building meaningful partnerships with internal and external stakeholders at all levels and across diverse backgrounds.

 - Willingness to travel up to 30% across the region for client meetings, events, and conferences.

We are currently seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our growing Consumer team. The Consumer team at Kraken focuses on building applications that expose Kraken's product offering to the mass market. Trying to onboard the next 100 million people to the benefits of crypto.

This role involves setting the technical direction for our "Consumer" applications — a suite of products aimed at offering the simplest way for our customers to interact with Kraken — and delivering the hardest parts of it yourself. The opportunity

 - Own the architecture and delivery of customer-facing Rust backend services powering trading, payments, and crypto experiences — making the design calls on systems that will outlive the feature you built them for

 - Take ambiguous, multi-quarter problems from "we think this matters" to shipped and measured, breaking them down so the rest of the team can move in parallel with you

 - Own features end-to-end rather than stopping at the API/backend boundary, and raise the bar on what "end-to-end" means for everyone around you — customer experience, frontend impact, and the product problem behind what you're building

 - Partner with product leadership to shape the roadmap for a product area, not just execute against it. You'll bring engineering insight that changes what gets built, and own the outcomes and metrics that follow

 - Drive initiatives that cross team boundaries — Kraken's trading infrastructure, platform, and other product teams — building the relationships and technical alignment needed to land them

 - Multiply the team: mentor mid-level engineers, review designs before code exists, unblock people quickly, and leave behind patterns and standards that make the next feature easier than the last

 - Use AI extensively to amplify scope and speed, moving from manually writing code toward orchestrating AI and validating implementation — and help the team do the same, defining what good AI-assisted engineering looks like here

What you bring

 - 6+ years of backend engineering experience, with deep Rust proficiency across network services, asynchronous code, and distributed systems design (RPC protocols, Kafka, event-driven architectures)

 - A track record of owning systems, not just features. You've made architectural decisions in production, lived with the consequences, and can explain the tradeoffs you'd make differently now

 - Product engineering mindset. You've shipped features from problem → implementation → launch → user impact, with deep understanding of customer experience and product metrics, and you've influenced what got built and what got cut

 - Demonstrated impact through others: mentoring, design review, technical writing, or setting standards that changed how a team worked

 - Experience driving work that spans teams or orgs, where the hard part was alignment and sequencing as much as the code

 - AI-first development approach where AI is already meaningfully incorporated into your workflow; you actively use AI for coding, understanding unfamiliar codebases, crossing technical boundaries, and validating implementations

 - Ownership mindset with collaborative spirit. You personally drive features end-to-end, work across backend/frontend boundaries, and operate outside technical silos

 - Openness to how the engineering profession is evolving because of AI, prioritizing shipping valuable products over manual code writing

Nice to haves

 - Full-stack experience including React/TypeScript or other frontend frameworks — valuable for demonstrating cross-boundary collaboration mindset

 - Experience building and scaling products at consumer-focused technology companies, ideally at meaningful user scale

description:
BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout,  xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

THE TEAM

Payward Services (PWS) is the Infrastructure arm of Payward, the parent company of Kraken, whose businesses span trading, payments, custody, banking, asset management, and services. PWS gives regulated businesses direct API access to the infrastructure that has powered Kraken for 15+ years.

Payward holds 100+ regulatory licences, operates in 190+ jurisdictions, and processes $2T+ in annual volume. Payward has also applied for a national trust company charter to offer custody and trust services to institutional and high-net-worth clients across the U.S. The company is backed by strategic investors including Citadel Securities, Jane Street, Deutsche Börse, and Nasdaq.

Operated through Paywards’s regulated entities, custody combines segregated client accounts, institutional-grade key management and cold storage, independent audit and control reporting, and direct connectivity into Kraken's exchange, staking, and financing rails. Clients get the security posture of a dedicated custodian alongside the liquidity and product depth of one of the longest-running exchanges in crypto.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As Senior Sales Lead, Custody & Wealth Management, you will lead the go-to-market efforts for Payward custody offering, including qualified custody, across two motions:

Institutional custody sales: Sell to banks, neobanks, fintechs, payment companies, brokerages, exchanges, asset managers, and any business that needs regulated digital asset custody, globally.

B2B2C wealth solutions: Work with Product to design and launch embedded custody and digital asset solutions. Private banks, wealth managers, family offices, and platforms serving high-net-worth clients can offer these to their own clients under their own brand, alongside PWS staking, trading, payments, and tokenized assets.

You will report to the Global Head of Sales, Payward Services, as a senior individual contributor. You will work closely with Solution Engineering, Product, Legal, Compliance, and Onboarding, and act as the voice of the custody and wealth market in roadmap discussions.

Lead  and help define the global GTM strategy for Custody across institutional segments, asset managers, ETF and fund issuers, hedge funds, market makers and prop firms, banks and wealth platforms, corporates and treasuries, family offices, token issuers and foundations, and exchanges requiring third-party custody. 

This role will be expected to:

 - Grow assets under custody and custody revenue as the primary outcomes, with clear ownership of targets, forecasting, and pipeline discipline

 - Develop commercial frameworks across custody, trading, and yield products including vaults and staking.

 - Lead revenue across a range of relationships from long cycle RFP driven enterprise mandates to mid-market motion for funds, corporates, and crypto-native clients who need to onboard fast.

 - Own the full client lifecycle from qualification and diligence through agreement negotiation, onboarding, and expansion into staking, trading, collateral, and settlement.

 - Build and scale a revenue growth in the custody and wealth management vertical across a global Sales and BD organization, with an AI-first approach to tooling, pipeline management, and operational efficiency.

 - Establish Payward as the default custodian across the institutional ecosystem, fund administrators, wealth managers, family offices, consultants, prime brokers, OTC desks, and the service providers who shape custodian space.

 - Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Finance to align commercial strategy with platform capability and the regulatory perimeter of each entity

 - Expand Payward’'s custody footprint across the UK, Europe, US and APAC and other priority markets, with a clear view on licensing constraints and how to sequence market entry

 - Feed the product roadmap with structured client demand: asset and chain coverage, staking, reporting and integrations, collateral mobility, and off-exchange settlement

WHAT YOU BRING

 - 7+ years of experience building and scaling B2B or B2B2C revenue organizations within digital asset custody, Wealth management, traditional custody and asset servicing, or regulated financial infrastructure

 - Proven track record closing and expanding complex, long-cycle mandates with institutional clients where security, regulatory, and operational diligence sit at the center of the buying decision

 - Deep understanding of the wealth management space, how institutions actually select a custodian, risk and investment committees, operational due diligence, asset segregation and bankruptcy remoteness, insurance, audit and control reporting, and multi-custodian mandates

 - Deep experience structuring custody economics: AUC-based pricing, minimums, revenue-share models, and multi-product commercial agreements

 - Strong commercial judgment, negotiation skills, and executive presence at the C-suite and board level

 - Experience building and leading high-performing global Sales and BD teams

 - Demonstrated ability to implement AI-first sales tooling, CRM discipline, and scalable go-to-market systems

 - International experience strongly preferred; US and European market knowledge

 - Genuine conviction in crypto and the future of financial market infrastructure or deep, transferable expertise from traditional custody, fund services, or prime brokerage with a clear path to crypto fluency

NICE TO HAVES

 - Direct experience selling qualified custody, staking, or prime brokerage services to institutional clients

 - Relationships across the institutional service provider ecosystem: fund administrators, auditors, consultants, transfer agents, and ETF issuers

 - Working knowledge of institutional key management (MPC, HSM, multi-sig), cold storage architecture, off-exchange settlement, and collateral mobility

 - Familiarity with KYC/AML frameworks and digital asset licensing regimes across multiple jurisdictions

 - Experience scaling a B2B sales motion from founder-led or relationship-led origination to a structured, team-driven engine

 - Experience selling into token issuers, foundations, and protocol treasuries alongside traditional financial institutions

 - Exposure to staking economics, validator operations, and the reporting institutions expect around both

description:
BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout,  xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

THE TEAM

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

We are looking for a Deputy Regional Information Security Officer to own ICT security, operational resilience, and regulatory compliance across a portfolio of entities at different stages of maturity, from established licensed operations to new markets launching under frameworks. This is not a support function. You will be the named security officer for your entities, accountable to their boards and their regulators.

This is a high-visibility, high-trust role for a security governance professional who thrives at the intersection of technology, compliance, and financial services, and who is energised by the challenge of building from the ground up as much as sustaining what already exists.

Payward is one of the world's most trusted and secure digital asset platforms, operating across a growing network of regulated entities spanning Europe, the Middle East, and Asia Pacific. As we expand into new markets and deepen our regulatory footprint, the demand for embedded, senior-level ICT security leadership at the entity level has never been higher.

THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Prepare, contribute and report to regional risk governance and board committee meetings, highlighting control status, risk exposure, and readiness

 - Execute risk assessments and control testing across UAE operations in line with VARA cybersecurity guidelines and security best practices

 - Maintain and review Business Impact Assessments (BIA), integrating findings into global resilience planning

 - Contribute to Business Continuity Plan (BCP) documentation, testing, and updates, including entity-specific scenarios

 - Collaborate with Group Security and IT to:

   - Align UAE-specific regulatory controls with global policies and control frameworks

   - Contribute to the development of security policies to meet international and UAE compliance requirements

 - Conduct security control validation and document evidence for internal/external audits

 - Participate in remediation planning for audit findings and track progress to closure

 - Support the RISO in preparing and submitting regulatory documentation to regulators

 - Prepare and present security and resilience reports for internal governance committees and local entity management

 - Assist in responses to regulatory examinations, including due diligence and compliance queries

 - Liaise with compliance and legal teams to interpret regulatory changes and propose control adaptations

 - Participate in the regional incident response process, assist with post-incident reviews, and support continuous improvement activities

 - Coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders to embed security requirements into operational processes

WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Regulatory Governance

   - Serve as the named ICT security officer for your appointed entities, with formal accountability for security risk, ICT governance, and resilience oversight at board level

   - Prepare and present security, risk, and compliance reporting to entity boards and senior management committees

   - Act as the primary point of contact for VARA and other relevant regulatory authorities on ICT and security matters -- including examinations, inspections, licensing interactions, and ongoing supervisory dialogue

   - Support entity go-live processes, including the establishment of ICT governance frameworks for new market launches from the ground up

   - As the portfolio evolves, engage with additional regulatory frameworks with support from the broader RISO team

 - ICT Risk and Security

   - Lead ICT and security risk assessments across your entity portfolio, maintaining live risk registers and tracking remediation against regulatory SLAs

   - Own entity-level ICT policies and ensure they remain aligned with VARA cybersecurity requirements, applicable local frameworks, and group standards

   - Coordinate control testing, evidence documentation, and audit preparation with global security and compliance teams

   - Manage the classification, escalation, and regulatory reporting of ICT-related incidents within the timeframes required by applicable regulators

 - Operational Resilience

   - Lead business impact assessments, critical function mapping, and business continuity planning at the entity level

   - Oversee continuity and recovery testing, ensuring outputs meet regulatory expectations and feed back into global resilience planning

   - Maintain oversight of ICT third-party dependencies and outsourcing arrangements in line with regulatory requirements

 - Group Liaison

   - Act as the primary interface between your entities and the RISO Lead, ensuring local regulatory requirements are accurately represented in group-level decisions

   - Drive local implementation of group frameworks, policies, and resilience standards, adapting them where jurisdiction-specific requirements demand

   - Represent entity priorities in group-led security initiatives and governance forums

WHAT YOU BRING

 - 7+ years of experience in information security governance, ICT risk management, or regulatory compliance in a regulated financial services, fintech, or virtual asset environment

 - Direct experience as a named regulatory contact, involvement in regulatory examinations, supervisory interactions, licensing processes, or equivalent

 - Familiarity with UAE regulatory frameworks. Experience with VARA or other virtual asset / crypto-native regulatory regimes is a significant advantage and strongly preferred

 - Demonstrated ability to build compliance or governance programs from the ground up, not only to maintain established ones

 - Experience conducting risk assessments, business impact analyses, and resilience planning at the entity level

 - Familiarity with ICT outsourcing and third-party risk management within group structures

 - Ability to translate technical risk into board-level narrative and regulatory-grade documentation

 - Comfortable operating across multiple jurisdictions simultaneously, each at a different stage of regulatory maturity

 - Strong project management skills and the ability to drive outcomes across cross-functional, globally distributed teams

 - Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CISA, or ISO27001 Lead Implementer preferred

 - Familiarity with EU frameworks such as DORA and MiCA is strongly preferred

WHY THIS ROLE

 - You will hold a named role within a regulated entity with accountability and board-level visibility

 - You will operate at the frontier of virtual asset regulation -- VARA is one of the most advanced and fastest-evolving crypto regulatory frameworks in the world, and you will be shaping how Kraken meets it from day one of market entry

 - You will build ICT governance programs from scratch for new market entries, not inherit and maintain what others have set up

 - You will work with direct exposure to C-level executives and regulators across multiple jurisdictions, in an environment that rewards ownership and technical depth equally

 - The scope of this role is intentionally designed to grow -- as Kraken's entity footprint expands, so does the portfolio and the regulatory breadth you will be exposed to, potentially including Asian and EU frameworks such as DORA

 - You will join a remote-first, international team shaping the future of crypto asset governance and resilience across some of the world's most demanding regulatory environments

THE TEAM

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The PR and Communications team manages Payward & Kraken’s reputation and oversees all aspects of the external communications strategy and execution globally.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Manager, Pro Trading & Derivatives Communications

 - The Manager of Pro Trading, Institutional & Derivatives Communications will inspire and support the team responsible for building and executing communications programs in support of Payward’s product strategy and Kraken's products and services targeted at professional traders, derivatives users and institutions globally.

 - Develop and execute an integrated external communications strategy aligned to Kraken's key business goals aimed at advancing the company's brand with key stakeholders across the pro trading, derivatives and institutional segments.

 - Develop strategies that expand Kraken's thought leadership positioning across professional and institutional client segments and work with the team in executing and expanding reach to new audiences through unique approaches to storytelling around trading products, risk management, and market infrastructure.

 - Develop and expand Kraken's bench of spokespeople in pro trading and derivatives, including building out key strategic messaging at the executive, product and segment level that resonates with traders, fund managers and institutional decision-makers.

 - Prepare communications materials including company announcements, talking points, media statements, speaker submissions, pitches and briefing materials tailored to professional and institutional audiences.

 - Build connectivity with multiple stakeholders including institutional partners, trading desks, market data providers, the communications team and key external agencies serving the pro/institutional space.

 - Bring social media first thinking to media relations and content, with particular attention to platforms and channels where professional traders and institutions gather.

 - Additional duties and responsibilities as assigned.

WHAT YOU BRING

 - Bachelor’s degree required along with 7+ years of proven experience leading and executing communications programs and initiatives, crypto experience preferred.

 - Highly proactive, determined and results driven.

 - Outstanding writing, editing and communications strategy skills. A hands on contributor with an ability to translate complex topics and capture the views and voices of senior leaders.

 - Experience working with a geographically dispersed workforce and managing complex communications challenges.

 - Experience working directly with executives to enhance executive presence, deliver strong messaging and improve presentation/interview skills.

 - A team player with a track record of success delivering high quality work in a fast paced, dynamic environment.

 - Experience leading, mentoring and scaling communications teams

 - Knowledgeable and passionate about the crypto industry
